cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Remove extra lines 1451-1452
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i '1451,1452d' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")

# Verify
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -n '1448,1456p' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("Fixed:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
